notes.title: An update is coming mid-June!　See Even Further Across the Field 👓
notes.content:
See Even Further Across the Field 👓

An update is coming mid-June!

You asked, we listened. We’re adding a camera adjustment feature that lets you see much farther across the map than before.

Spot towers easily while exploring or track down that monster you’re after.

Enjoy a smoother, more exploration-friendly Fantasy Life!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/b1ebad47e2934a4b6cfd518e23b60968fb3cb72d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/4c3ed743b4a0a4b16cb0ca2b57b70aa4103bf493.png"]

notes.title: Digital Pre-Orders Now Available! Secure Your Bonus Rewards
notes.content:
Pre-orders have officially started today!
If you pre-order the game you’ll receive luxurious in-game items, including the Flutter Charm, which boosts gained experience.
Don't miss out & get ready for your adventure today!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/4f29135d2c088cc2e1595557906fe8a4cb5f8d65.png

Moreover, the Digital Deluxe Edition comes packed with exclusive rewards, 
such as the Mini Napdragon mount, limited-edition weapons and other special gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/06c49b7323a5ee97bb453cae236514d00c8c4232.png

For more details, please visit our official website: 
https://www.fantasylife.jp/fli/en/product/ 

Disclaimer:
The pre-order bonus item "Celestia’s Gift x100" announced on 14 February 2025, has been replaced with "Paralyzing Bomb + x5" as of 18 March 2025.
The start date for the "Advanced Access" on Steam included with the Digital Deluxe Edition is differing from the date we announced previously. 
We are currently investigating the issue and will provide an update as soon as more details become available. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
